tests.visual_review: Kneeling and arms behind head followed; reference face and hairstyle retained; yellow floral top, pink skirt, beige coat and bag transferred, with garment layering interpretation.
Standing and arms behind head followed; identity broadly retained; beige knit, puffer, dark green skirt, bag and boots transferred. Headwear omitted and puffer sleeves differ.

limitations: Only two single-person front poses and two outfits tested. Broad pose, identity and clothing transfer work, but garment construction, headwear, accessories, occlusion and exact facial likeness can deviate.
